subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative labels to full local date/time, and if so should it use the existing locale formatter or a fixed YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format?
rationale: The source problem is clear, but choosing the permanent display policy for a core Control UI table is a maintainer UX decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Adopt full date display
options.body: Accept the issue direction, land or replace the linked PR, and decide whether the formatter should be locale-based or fixed-width.

options.title: Keep relative display
options.body: Close or reject the request as intentional if the Sessions list should prioritize compact relative recency over exact dates.

options.title: Use hybrid display
options.body: Show one format in the cell and the other in a tooltip or details affordance if maintainers want both scanability and exactness.

recommendation.title: Adopt full date display
recommendation.body: Accept the issue direction, land or replace the linked PR, and decide whether the formatter should be locale-based or fixed-width.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest recent history on the Sessions view refactor that owns this table surface.
